title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Missouri-Kansas City
description: Ten under-21-safe Kansas City food stops with currently published late-hours information; confirm availability before leaving campus.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies — Westport
cards.subtitle: 505 Westport Road, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the Westport listing to plan a cookie pickup; its posted Thursday–Saturday hours run as late as 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A cookie shop with clearly posted late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westport listing posts hours until 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday for Insomnia Cookies at 505 Westport Road.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Friday and noon–3 a.m. Saturday; other days close at 1 a.m.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies — Power & Light
cards.subtitle: 54 E. 14th Street, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Check the district’s venue page before heading downtown; it lists cookies, brownies, ice cream, and late daily hours.
cards.short_summary: Downtown cookies and desserts with a 3 a.m. posted close.
cards.evidence_claim: Power & Light District lists Insomnia Cookies at 54 E. 14th Street, open until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 9 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Friday and 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: El Pueblito
cards.subtitle: 810 Southwest Boulevard, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: For a weekend option, use the restaurant’s own hours page and aim for Friday or Saturday, when it lists a 4:30 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Southwest Boulevard restaurant with very late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: El Pueblito lists Friday and Saturday opening hours of 10 a.m.–4:30 a.m. at 810 Southwest Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Posted Friday–Saturday hours end at 4:30 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday hours are listed through midnight.

cards.title: Town Topic Hamburgers
cards.subtitle: 20th & Broadway, Crossroads Arts District, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s location note for an around-the-clock downtown meal stop; it identifies this as its 24/7 location.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown diner whose official site identifies a 24/7 location.
cards.evidence_claim: Town Topic states that its location at 20th and Broadway in the Crossroads Arts District is open 24 hours, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s site describes the 20th & Broadway location as open 24 hours, seven days a week.

cards.title: Big Back Eatery
cards.subtitle: 7208 Prospect Avenue, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Plan around the posted late-week carryout schedule; the site lists service through 5 a.m. on Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Prospect Avenue eatery publishing overnight carryout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Big Back Eatery lists carryout hours through 5 a.m. Wednesday through Saturday at 7208 Prospect Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Posted carryout hours run midnight–5 a.m. Wednesday and 5 p.m.–5 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell — Prospect Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1420 Prospect Avenue, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant page for a drive-through pickup; it currently lists the drive-through as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour drive-through option on Prospect Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists 24-hour drive-through service every day at 1420 Prospect Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-through hours as open 24 hours daily; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: McDonald's — NW 83rd Terrace
cards.subtitle: 6830 NW 83rd Terrace, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: For an overnight drive-through order, rely on the location’s official schedule rather than lobby hours, which end at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A McDonald’s location with a separately posted 24-hour drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists its drive-through at 6830 NW 83rd Terrace as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is posted 24 hours daily; restaurant and lobby hours are posted as 5 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Denny's — Taney Street
cards.subtitle: 2117 Taney Street, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use Denny’s location page when you need an all-hours sit-down or takeout option; it specifically lists round-the-clock breakfast.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner with dine-in and takeout services listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its restaurant at 2117 Taney Street as open 24 hours and identifies round-the-clock breakfast service.
cards.access_notes: Official location page states “Open 24 Hours” and shows every day as open 24 hours.

cards.title: IHOP — N Chouteau Trafficway
cards.subtitle: 4337 N Chouteau Trafficway, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Check the official location page for a 24-hour restaurant option; it lists dine-in, takeout, and late-night food amenities.
cards.short_summary: An IHOP with all-day published hours and late-night food listed.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 4337 N Chouteau Trafficway restaurant as open 24 hours every day and offering late-night food.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts “Open 24 Hours” for Monday through Sunday and lists late-night food among amenities.

cards.title: La Bamba Restaurant and Cantina
cards.subtitle: 8500 E. US Highway 40, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own business-hours listing for an overnight weekday pickup; it currently posts 24-hour Tuesday and Wednesday availability.
cards.short_summary: An east Kansas City restaurant with published overnight midweek hours.
cards.evidence_claim: La Bamba Restaurant and Cantina lists Tuesday and Wednesday as open 24 hours at 8500 E. US Highway 40.
cards.access_notes: The business’s posted hours list Tuesday and Wednesday as open 24 hours; verify the day-specific schedule before travel.
